report.summary: Reviewed chunk 8 of embeddings.py: defines _verify_identity and verify_index_identity; checks identity anchor reproduction, model drift, and backend availability.
risks: verify_index_identity | medium | Calls _verify_identity with force=True but does not handle case where _backend(host) raises. | Check if _backend can raise and if caller handles it.
todos: verify_index_identity calls _backend(host) which may raise; consider exception handling.

handoff.purpose: Define _verify_identity and verify_index_identity for identity anchor verification.

symbols.name: _verify_identity
symbols.note: Private method; returns None if safe, OperationStatus if refusal. Updates _identity_verified set and database.

symbols.name: verify_index_identity
symbols.note: Public method; calls _verify_identity with force=True, then checks anchor provenance.

claims.text: Return a refusal status when the backend no longer matches the index.
claims.why: The method returns OperationStatus with 'model_drift' or other errors if backend doesn't match.

claims.text: None means 'safe to proceed': either the identity anchor still reproduces, or there is no anchor yet to reproduce.
claims.why: Returns None when anchor is None, already verified, or successfully reproduced.

claims.text: Re-check an index against the live backend, ignoring the cache.
claims.why: Calls _verify_identity with force=True, which checks _identity_verified only if force=False.

observations.what: verify_index_identity calls _backend(host) which may raise, but no try-except around it.
verify_index_identity returns status 'unanchored' when anchor_provenance is 'missing', but does not check for other provenance values.
The docstring of _verify_identity mentions 'identity anchor still reproduces' but the code also handles backend unavailability and protocol errors.
